historical_record.note: Phase-1 confirmations C0 (3000-3049), A (4000-4049) and B (6000-6049), their archives under archived_results/, and the manuscript drafts are historical and are neither re-run nor overwritten. V3 writes only to results_v3/.

confirmation.rule: Untouched until FROZEN; spent after the first completed run regardless of outcome.

conditions.definition: 9 sensitivities at sigma 0.5, plus sigma 1.0 and 2.0 at s 1.0. s 0.5 lies outside the 0.6-1.4 training range.

controller_notes.DR_H4: PRIMARY learned model: 10000-epoch retrained, best-validation checkpoint. Selection rule fixed before the development rehearsal; stays primary regardless of S5.
controller_notes.DR_H4_900: SECONDARY arm (S5 only): unmodified phase-1 Experiment-A weights (900-epoch budget). Not retrained or altered.
controller_notes.PI_sens_ref: Sensitivity-informed tuned PI reference: per-sensitivity best member of the searched PI family. Uses knowledge of s, so it is not deployable; it is the best PI this search found, not an upper bound on classical control. Not hypothesis-tested.
controller_notes.ARX_fixed: OLS prior; online update disabled (lam and p_scale unused).

arx_prior.source: OLS on training plants 2000-2099 (identical to the Experiment B prior)

protocol.equivalence_margin_justification: Carried over unchanged from the Experiment B protocol (locked 8 Oct 2026, before its confirmation). It is about 15% of DR-H4 RMSE at s 0.6 in every phase-1 confirmation and was not re-chosen after phase-2 development data.

statistics.learned_model_reduction: mean over five initialisations within plant before differencing
statistics.interval: BCa bootstrap of the mean paired plant-level difference

P1.decision: supported iff the lower bound is > 0 at both conditions

P2.decision: supported iff the whole interval lies within +/-0.25 Hz

B1.decision: none; no direction assumed; all reported

S2.output: mean RMSE and ranking per condition (PI_sens_ref shown, excluded from ranking); crossovers described, none assumed

S3.note: plant-level; replaces the cell-level C0 interval

S5.unit: plant; each arm averaged over all five initialisations (seeds 101-105) within plant; no seed selection
S5.decision: none; never promoted to primary whatever the outcome
S5.motivation: Added after the development rehearsal showed that the 10000-epoch models, despite lower one-step validation error, tracked worse in closed loop at s >= 0.8 than the 900-epoch phase-1 models.

comparison_count.note: Each family is corrected only within itself. Conditions (11) are not comparisons.

runtime_estimate.estimate_minutes: about 20 on the laptop (resumable 160-s chunks); rehearsal without the 900-epoch arm took 15

prediction_metrics.note: One-step validation RMSE (plants 2100-2129) is a prediction metric, reported separately from closed-loop tracking RMSE; no causal link between them is assumed.

training_notes: DR_H4 seed 103 had a transient validation spike (3.84 Hz) at epoch 10000; its best-validation checkpoint (epoch 9986, 1.393 Hz) is used.
Retraining ran on the laptop in resumable 165-s chunks with Adam state checkpointed; maths identical to experiment_a.MLP.fit except the 10000-epoch budget.
flags: PI_sens_ref[s0.70].kt=1 is on the grid edge [0, 1]
ARX_RLS.p_scale=1e+09 is the largest tested; the objective is a plateau (6 configs within 0.02 Hz of best, see arx_plateau), so the grid was not extended

best epoch >= 9950 for ['DR_H4_101', 'DR_H4_103', 'DR_Memoryless_141_102']; validation gain over the last 1000 epochs {'DR_H4_101': 0.006, 'DR_H4_103': 0.0054, 'DR_Memoryless_141_102': 0.0027} Hz - treated as converged in practice
prohibitions: No tuning or model selection on 7000-7049
No change of hypotheses, margins or alpha after FROZEN
Report all controllers and conditions regardless of outcome

decisions.S1_S5: secondary/exploratory; reported with stated alpha, no decision rule; S5 never promoted to primary
